scope: Local positive-learning and measurement calibration; mechanism diagnostic only, not architecture promotion, economics or transfer.

recipe.scheduler: pinned nanoGPT get_lr(it), it=0..4999, explicit 5000 updates (not upstream inclusive 5001 loop)
recipe.sample_policy: uniform valid start offsets in train only, with replacement, paired seed controls
recipe.checkpoint_evaluation: entire dev split; also initialization and update 5000
recipe.selection: minimum dev bpb among all scheduled trained checkpoints; ties choose earliest update
recipe.early_stop: none; interruption/time cap before 5000 updates is budget-inconclusive, not successful completion
recipe.precision: CUDA bfloat16 autocast with FP32 parameters, optimizer state and cross-entropy logits
recipe.attention: PyTorch causal scaled_dot_product_attention; record actual backend and CUDA environment
recipe.reproducibility: seed Python, NumPy, torch and CUDA; no promise of cross-device bitwise determinism

budget.service_charge_kind: conservative reservation; exact initial wall clock not recorded
budget.worker_layout: one fit seed per EXP/cycle; trained/frozen and scalar controls returned by one diagnostic worker within 1800 s
budget.final_series: three one-seed EXP plans with identical frozen recipe; aggregate once after all three; no inter-replicate tuning
budget.seed_integration_required: new cohort-specific one-seed execution policy plus enforced three-distinct-seed series gate; leave historical seed policies unchanged
budget.cap_policy: stop and report exact blocker; no new names, silent retries or post-result budget enlargement

controls.causal: same source and same initial parameters, train optimizer on versus frozen initialization
controls.unexpected_control_pass_policy: invalidate measurement, not the transformer family

evaluation.windows: within each split, x=s[a:a+256], y=s[a+1:a+257], a=0,256,...; shorter tail included with masking; no cross-split context
evaluation.target_count: split_bytes - 1; each target exactly once, no averaging of averages
evaluation.final_data_access: after all dev attempts ended and recipe, code, evaluator and all-series policy are frozen
evaluation.uncertainty: all seed values, mean, sample SD, range and paired Student-t interval with df=2; conditional on this single corpus, assumptions explicit

measurement.hardware: local NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070, 12878086144 device bytes; torch 2.6.0+cu124
measurement.mode: one GPU worker, no concurrent research jobs; record driver, CPU, RAM, clocks and background load without changing user applications
measurement.latency: batch=1, context=256, one next-byte output; no KV cache; preprocessing/H2D/forward/argmax/D2H included; synchronize both boundaries
measurement.throughput: teacher-forced contexts of 256 bytes with all per-token outputs; not autoregressive generation rate
measurement.prompts: fixed dev windows, disjoint selection not necessary for measurement but no final text; hashes recorded
measurement.operation_cost: explicit parameter/MAC accounting, with FLOPs estimates labeled estimates; never substitute GPU seconds for complexity

activation_requirements: Implement new cohort evaluator, claim-specific diagnostic schema/gates and candidate interface under logged no-scoring maintenance.
Test all control fixtures and preserve the old evaluator manifest/cohort; then freeze new evaluator and semantic-baseline certificate.
Enforce one-seed per-run deep budget, three unique final seeds and full series provenance; do not reinterpret the old matrix K/D as corpus scaling.
Make restart state progression explicit without weakening maintenance; append PC-01-HARNESS progress and retain this contract.
Before any tested candidate implementation register an immutable EXP plan through nextai plan new; scored execution only via nextai run --plan.
Run at most three registered development attempts without final access; freeze selected implementation before the final series.
At service cap, report ready or blocked. Missing integration is not authorization to train directly.

outcomes.valid_positive: three valid learning replicates pass with all measurement controls; keep calibrated apparatus, not a promoted architecture
outcomes.valid_negative: completed valid recipe fails learning thresholds; close this tested version, review control suitability
outcomes.inconclusive: crash, timeout, missing/inverted control, leakage, seed reuse, invalid provenance or incomplete series; retain every artifact
outcomes.after_final: no holdout-guided repair; changed question needs a new contract and fresh final data
